- [ ] I, the PR author, have personally reviewed every line of this PR.

## What does this PR do?

Builds on merged #8478; rebased onto `main` at `88312648a`.

Use one weakly held list of `ExecutionEvent(module, phase)` values and one cursor. Registration mode fills the list during construction; recorded mode fills it from execution. Both use the same validation, lookahead, and argument-free `advance()`, which wraps automatically.

Registration mode requires a complete forward/backward sequence matching its preset; reordered or repeated execution needs recorded mode. Lookahead follows successive execution events and gathers parameters for each event's phase. Phase changes do not stop prefetch; the existing prefetch budgets still apply.

This PR changes three production files and two test files. Schedule completion, PP/VPP and EP-overlap integration, and evaluation handling are in the separate follow-up #8778.

## Validation

Black, isort, Pylint, Ruff, and `git diff --check` passed.

Eos job `6418873`, exact commit `3900deaf46ebea085ed567f908dd4b81f02576f9`: **25 focused tests passed on each of eight H100 GPUs**.

The divergence test runs a model whose forward executes its layers in the opposite order from registration and checks that it raises. Coverage also includes execution-order cursors, recorded replay, pipeline context sharing, and activation recomputation.

The cached dev CI image uses NGC 26.08; the repository pins 26.09.

## Code provenance

Refactors this repository's FSDP code and tests, building on #8478 and the event representation proposed in [#8485 at a3c0982](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/commit/a3c098282a0ffc66a6518a29c3779a703b0e43fd). Existing copyright and license notices are preserved. No code copied from other repositories.
